Messages.Author: brando...@hotmail.com
Messages.Body:
I'm having trouble finding where it says the restrictions on what
equipment allies can use. There are different kinds of allies, like
animal, mortal, and non-mortal, and you would think there would be
some restrictions, but I don't know what they are. Anyone care to
enlighten me? Can my underbridge stray tote an assault rifle?
Thanks,

Brandon

Messages.Author: dolor...@gmail.com
Messages.Body:


Yes.

Most equipment restrictions are clan based so obviously your allies
can't equip with them.

Even so, they can USE most of the equipment with clan restrictions as
well. Some say "The so-and-so-clan vampire with this equipment..." so
allies (or other vampires) can't use those.

Also, allies can't use equipment or locquipment which has a blood cost
since they have life.

Kittehs with guns ftw!

Jeff

Messages.Author: tigernat1
Messages.Body:

I would say they can USE it, they just can't equip it. If there was a
way to get it onto them, they could use it. Unless, by blood cost, you
mean a blood cost to "activate" the equipment, like the blood cost of
Guarded Rubrics to bleed with it, for example.
